questions: Preserve DIRECT without planning overhead; distinguish size from semantic coupling.
Measure request validation, explicit invocation and promotion of remaining outcomes.
decision: Keep a small selective router; add measured near-miss and promotion contracts instead of a second classifier model.
code_observations: The entrypoint already distinguishes DIRECT, FINAL_PLAN and PRIMARY_PLAN. DIRECT is an early exit, not the removal of model-capability or optional validation safeguards.
requestctl and promotectl separate intake from promotion. The latter preserves completed outcomes so promotion need not manufacture retrospective TODOs.
implementation_steps: Extend the existing routing corpus with short high-risk changes, long repetitive logs, medium cohesive CRUDs, unrelated workstreams and nearly finished tasks under context pressure. Preserve explicit invocation behavior.
Represent a route decision with bounded reason codes, estimated working set and remaining outcomes. Do not persist a plan or load orchestration references on a negative implicit match.
Add a promotion regression that retains edits and completed tests while creating TODOs only for outstanding deliverables. Keep source evidence pointers rather than copied conversation history.
Keep exact lifecycle/configuration commands outside semantic routing. Document the optional validate-or-fix exit in one short pointer, not an eagerly loaded monitoring manual.
proposed_acceptance_tests: A one-module feature touching seven files remains DIRECT and leaves no plan artifacts.
A short security-sensitive fix remains direct when cohesive, but its model floor is not lowered.
A promoted task includes only remaining outcomes and preserves the original worktree.
Measure entrypoint bytes, referenced files actually loaded and routing false-positive/false-negative cases against baseline.

alternatives.title: Retain heuristic routing unchanged
alternatives.tradeoff: Lowest change cost, but missing near-miss cases remain unmeasured.

alternatives.title: Deterministic regression corpus plus compact reasons
alternatives.tradeoff: Low runtime overhead; exposes ambiguous decisions without another inference call.

alternatives.title: Always classify with a separate LLM or always orchestrate
alternatives.tradeoff: Adds latency, tokens and a new failure point even for one grep or a small edit.

cost_model: Use no additional model invocation for route selection. The value is avoided unnecessary orchestration, measured as artifact count and prompt bytes; dollar savings remain unmeasured.
unverified: Natural-language route choice still needs host evaluation; passing string checks alone does not prove correct semantic routing.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
